privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.updated: Version 2026-10. This notice explains how SideHustle handles personal data under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA).
privacy.draft: Draft for the Lagos pilot. Items in [brackets] must be filled in, and the notice reviewed by a lawyer, before launch.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: SideHustle Marketplace is operated by [company legal name, RC number, registered address], the data controller. Contact our Data Protection Officer at [dpo@ email address].

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Your name, business name, phone number, email, state and selling interests; delivery addresses and recipient details; what you order and pay; custom requests you send; sign-in records (device and IP address). For vendors: business details, staff contacts and licence documents. Card details are entered on Paystack's page and never reach our servers.

use.title: Why we use it and our lawful basis
use.body: To create and run your account and deliver your orders (performing our contract with you); to verify your phone and email and prevent fraud (legitimate interests); to keep order, payment and tax records (legal obligation); and to send tips and deals only if you opt in (consent, which you can withdraw at any time from your account page).

share.title: Who we share it with
share.body: Vendors receive the name, phone and address they need to ship your order. Our processors help us run the service: Paystack (payments), our SMS and email providers, our hosting and storage providers, and logistics partners. Each acts on our instructions under a written agreement. We do not sell personal data.

transfer.title: Data leaving Nigeria
transfer.body: Some processors store data outside Nigeria, [list providers and countries]. We only transfer data where the NDPA allows it, for example to a country with adequate protection or under contractual safeguards approved by the NDPC.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.body: Order and payment records: 6 years, as accounting and tax law requires; after that the delivery details are removed. Sign-in records: 90 days after they end. Message logs: 1 year. Codes and email links: 30 days. Custom request text: 2 years. When you delete your account, everything else is removed straight away.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can see and download your data, correct it, delete your account, object to or restrict some uses, withdraw consent, and move your data to another service. Do most of this yourself from your account page, or email [dpo@ email address]; we answer within 30 days. If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, you can complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (ndpc.gov.ng).

security.title: Security
security.body: Data is encrypted in transit; passwords are stored with a memory-hard hash; staff access is limited and logged. If a breach puts your rights at risk, we will tell the NDPC within 72 hours and tell you without undue delay.

children.title: Age
children.body: SideHustle is for adults running a business. You must be 18 or older to open an account.
